## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Configuration and settings: `CU_APP_CONFIGURATION` holds typed key/value settings as platform defaults
(`TENANT_ID NULL`) and tenant overrides; `SettingsApi` resolves a key tenant override → platform default →
`NoSuchSettingException`, cached as `erpCoreSettings` keyed `<tenantId>:<KEY>`. Written through
`/api/v1/common/configurations` (`?scope=PLATFORM` from the platform operator tenant), which evicts the cache.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
For every value an operator may change without a deployment: limits, toggles, defaults, sender names, thresholds.
The module owns its keys (`<MODULE>_<NAME>`), may seed their platform defaults in a `V1000+` migration and reads
them through `SettingsApi` at use time. Deployment-level properties of the application itself stay in its own
`@ConfigurationProperties`.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// a typed read with a built-in default
int maxLines = settingsApi.getOrDefault("SHOP_ORDER_MAX_LINES", Integer.class, 200);

// a required setting (NoSuchSettingException → the module's error code)
Duration hold = settingsApi.find("SHOP_STOCK_HOLD", Duration.class)
    .orElseThrow(() -> new LocalizedException(Status.BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION, ShopErrorCodes.SETTING_MISSING, "SHOP_STOCK_HOLD"));

// erp-core 1.6.0 — a limit a tenant may only tighten: the platform default beside the tenant's effective value
Duration cap = settingsApi.findPlatformDefault("SHOP_MAX_HOLD", Duration.class).orElse(Duration.ofDays(7));
Duration effective = settingsApi.find("SHOP_MAX_HOLD", Duration.class).filter(v -> v.compareTo(cap) < 0).orElse(cap);
```

```sql
-- V1000+: a platform default every tenant inherits until it writes an override
INSERT INTO CU_APP_CONFIGURATION (ID, TENANT_ID, CONFIG_KEY, CONFIG_VALUE, NOTES, IS_ACTIVE_FL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT)
VALUES (nextval('SEQ_CU_APP_CONFIGURATION'), NULL, 'SHOP_ORDER_MAX_LINES', '200', 'Lines per order', 1, 'SYSTEM', now());
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
